name: Starlink Group 15-24
slot_a_text: Low Earth orbit is anywhere from about 160 to 2,000 km up, where a satellite laps the planet roughly every 90 minutes. Everything there is falling; it just keeps missing the ground.
slot_b_text: 57 launches from SLC-4E so far this year. 295 in total since it opened. It turns around in about 4 days.
description: A batch of 27 satellites for the Starlink mega-constellation - SpaceX's project for space-based Internet communication system.
program_description: Starlink is a satellite internet constellation operated by American aerospace company SpaceX
rocket_fact: The soot on a landed Falcon 9 is rarely cleaned off fully, giving flight-proven boosters a distinct dirty look.
